dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: Thank you, and mine to you... If you don't mind, please take this.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: This is called a Windwheel Aster. I asked a friend to bring one back from Mondstadt for me.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: There, this plant symbolizes the "visible winds." I hope it can keep my husband safe at sea.

dialogues.speaker: Chunshui
dialogues.text: You are a good person. I hope that you, too, may be blessed be the wind.
